title: 第18章 死去的复仇第19章 院管的到来
content_zh:
：宿管听了之后，表情沉思了一会儿，看着我面露诡异的说道：“小子，我看你身上命格并不一般，你确定要插手此事吗？弄不好的话，你会在次陨落的！”
我看着面前诡异的宿管，从包里掏出桃木剑，握紧在双手，壮了壮胆子，语气狠厉的说道：“小子我福大命大！
就不劳烦前辈多心。”
宿管听见我的话之后，诡异的表情慢慢平静了下来，恢复成一开始见到他那淡陌的表情，仔细打量了一下，我点了点头说道：“小子，既然你执意要插手此事的话，老婆子我也无权干涉，祝你好运吧。”
宿管说完又回到了自己的房间，打开电视看了起来，仿佛我不曾出现一般。
我看着面前如此诡异的宿管，心里面甚是谨慎，不过还是踏步踏入了学生宿舍。
刚进入学生宿舍，相比昨天的温度又下降了几度，我寒毛竖立，鸡皮疙瘩瞬间起了上来，我掏出桃木剑，慢慢的向着楼上走去。
应该是因为今天发生的跳楼事件，整个学生宿舍鸦雀无声，包括走廊的灯光也不再亮起，整个宿舍好像除了宿管以外，我再也没看到这任何一个活人。
“哥哥，陪我玩好吗？”
就在这时，我身后传来一名诡异的声音，我吓得急忙回头一看，发现一名红衣小女孩站在我眼前，怀里还抱着一个玩偶熊。
透过月光，我看见小女孩的脚下居然没有影子！
我身上鸡皮疙瘩瞬间掉了一地，我急忙掏出桃木剑对向小女孩。
而面前的小女孩无视了我的动作只是奶声奶气的说道：“哥哥，陪我玩捉迷藏吧，要是被我找到的话，就永远留在这陪我吧！”
“十…九…”
这时小女孩紧闭双眼，淡淡的数着数字，而身体的皮肤也渐渐的腐蚀了起来，显得格外吓人！
我急忙收起桃木剑，向楼上飞快的跑去！
我敢肯定，我绝对不是她的对手，现在只能先躲藏起来，等待赵史来支援。
我急忙躲在一旁的宿舍，进入宿舍便发现空荡荡的，啥也没有，只有残留的几本作业，看来宿舍里面的人今天肯定搬了出去！
“好了哥哥，千万要躲好哦，不要让我找到你，否则的话…”
此时整个宿舍回荡起小女孩的声音，声音虽显稚嫩，可听在我的耳中，犹如恶鬼索命一般。

我急忙把宿舍的桌椅全部堆放在门口，希望能挡住小女孩的前进方向。
“哥哥~你是在这里面吧~”
此时门口处传来小女孩稚嫩的声音，我听了之后，身上的鸡皮疙瘩掉了一地，整个人蜷缩在衣柜之中，不敢出声。
“啊~哥哥好过分，居然耍赖把门锁着了。”
小女孩推了推门，发现宿舍门纹丝不动，抱怨的声音传了过来。
我心里正庆幸着，小女孩应该暂时是进入不来了，便慢慢放松了下来。
“砰！”
就在这时门被撞开了！
紧靠着门上的桌椅散落一地，我感受到一股强大的怨气侵入而来！
我急忙捂住口鼻，大气不敢喘一声，只听见小女孩的脚步在我耳边踏！
踏！
的走着。
“难道是不在吗？”
就在这时，我透过衣柜，听见小女孩传来疑惑的声音，脚步声慢慢向外走了过去。
content_en:
: After listening to this, the dormitory guard looked thoughtful for a while, looked at me with a strange expression and said: "Boy, I think your destiny is not ordinary. Are you sure you want to get involved in this matter? If you don't do it right, you will die next time!"
I looked at the strange dormitory in front of me, took out the mahogany sword from my bag, held it tightly in both hands, emboldened me, and said in a stern tone: "Boy, I am blessed with great fortune!
I won’t bother my seniors to worry too much. "
After hearing my words, the strange expression of the dormitory slowly calmed down and returned to the indifferent expression when I first saw him. After looking at him carefully, I nodded and said, "Boy, since you insist on intervening in this matter, I have no right to interfere, old lady. I wish you good luck."
After the dormitory manager finished speaking, he went back to his room, turned on the TV and started watching it, as if I had never been there.
Looking at the strange dormitory in front of me, I felt very cautious, but I still stepped into the student dormitory.
As soon as I entered the student dormitory, the temperature dropped a few degrees compared to yesterday. My hair stood on end and goosebumps suddenly appeared on my skin. I took out my mahogany sword and walked slowly upstairs.
Probably because of the jumping incident that happened today, the entire student dormitory was silent, including the lights in the corridor. It seemed that except for the dormitory manager, I never saw any living person in the entire dormitory.
"Brother, can you play with me?"
At this moment, a strange voice came from behind me. I was so frightened that I quickly looked back and found a little girl in red standing in front of me, holding a stuffed bear in her arms.
Through the moonlight, I saw that there was no shadow under the little girl's feet!
Goosebumps fell all over my body instantly. I quickly took out my mahogany sword and pointed it at the little girl.
The little girl in front of me ignored my actions and just said in a sweet voice: "Brother, play hide and seek with me. If you are found by me, stay here with me forever!"
"Ten...nine..."
At this time, the little girl closed her eyes tightly and counted the numbers lightly, and the skin of her body gradually corroded, looking particularly scary!
I hurriedly put away the mahogany sword and ran upstairs quickly!
I am sure that I am definitely no match for her. Now I can only hide and wait for Zhao Shi to come for support.
I hurriedly hid in the dormitory aside. When I entered the dormitory, I found it was empty. There was nothing but a few remaining homework books. It seemed that the people in the dormitory must have moved out today!
"Okay, brother, be sure to hide and don't let me find you, otherwise..."
At this time, the whole dormitory echoed with the little girl's voice. Although the voice was childish, it sounded to my ears like an evil ghost demanding life.
I hurriedly piled all the tables and chairs in the dormitory at the door, hoping to block the little girl's direction.
"Brother~ You are in here~"
At this time, the childish voice of the little girl came from the door. After I heard it, goosebumps fell all over my body, and I huddled in the closet, not daring to make a sound.
"Ah~ Brother is so outrageous. He even pretended to lock the door."
The little girl pushed the door and found that the dormitory door was not moving at all, and the voice of complaint came over.
I was glad in my heart that the little girl probably couldn't enter for the time being, so I slowly relaxed.
"Bang!"
Just then the door was knocked open!
The tables and chairs next to the door were scattered on the floor, and I felt a powerful wave of resentment coming in!
I hurriedly covered my mouth and nose, not daring to breathe loudly. I only heard the little girl's footsteps walking beside my ears!
tread!
walking.
"Isn't he here?"
At this moment, through the closet, I heard the little girl's confused voice and footsteps walking slowly outside.
